'''Mantabogs''' were a type of blanket-shaped airborne constrictor from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. At some point after the mantabog went extinct, a [[Hologram/Legends|holodiarama]] of the creatures was displayed at the [[Holographic Zoo of Extinct Animals]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], ranking among the most popular exhibits in the establishment.<ref name="C&CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mantabogs were mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' produced by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="C&CW" />
